services.name: Flight Experiences
services.desc: Whether you're seeking the thrill of open-cockpit flying or the majesty of our legendary "Whiskey 7," we offer unforgettable experiences for every aviation enthusiast. Each flight helps preserve these irreplaceable pieces of history for future generations. Experience history aboard our legendary D-Day veteran. This fully operational C-47A flew paratroopers over Normandy and continues to honor that legacy through passenger flights. Fly in an open-cockpit vintage WACO CSO Straightwing! This 235 HP three-seat gem takes two passengers plus pilot for an authentic 1920s flying experience. One passenger at a time for an intimate flying experience with excellent views of the beautiful Finger Lakes

services.name: Museum Exhibits
services.desc: Explore current exhibitions, permanent displays, and rotating installations that bring aviation history to life Discover the inspiring stories of local men and women who overcame adversity to serve in aviation roles during and after WWII, including Tuskegee Airmen, WASP pilots, and other barrier-breaking aviators from the region. Our exhibits connect visitors to the human stories behind aviation history. Every uniform, photograph, and personal letter represents someone who served, creating emotional connections that bring textbook history to life. Our exhibits evolve regularly with new acquisitions, rotating displays, and seasonal presentations. Recent donations and ongoing research
